message:
I still can't finish this, and nothing has changed since my last two messages. `test/users-nickname.test.js` still fails and I haven't edited any files.

The test needs a `nickname` column on `users`. That takes a new file in `migrations/`, which your Fenceline rule ("migrations: off-limits, the DBA team owns them") blocks. A repeated "continue" doesn't lift that rule. Adding the column from app code or test setup would get around it, so I won't.

Reply with one of these:
- **"Go ahead with migration 003."** I'll add the one-line `migrations/003_add_nickname.js`, update `src/api/users.js`, and run `npm test`.
- **"The DBA team will add it."** Tell me when the column exists and I'll make only the `users.js` change.

Or you can change the Fenceline rule yourself with `/fenceline:fence`.
